run.name: EverCommerce Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (EVCM)
run.summary: EverCommerce has moderate leverage of 2.98x gross and 2.22x net, ample liquidity and no term loan maturity before 2031, but flat earnings, large add-backs and sponsor-directed shareholder returns leave the credit view stable with a negative earnings bias. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal debt 523.875 US$m (10-Q June 2026 page:18) over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 175.819 US$m (FY2025 plus H1 2026 less H1 2025; 10-K page:131, 10-Q June 2026 page:39); cash 133.496 US$m (page:5). Not the covenant ratio; credit agreement definition not supplied.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 175.819 US$m over LTM cash interest 33.109 US$m (35.708 plus 15.645 less 18.244; 10-Q June 2026 page:8). Same limits.

cash.basis: Cash. Same cash; undrawn commitments after the expiry of the 30.0 US$m tranche, 125.0 US$m maturing July 29, 2030 (page:53). A subsequent event relative to the balance sheet date but before the cutoff. Not net of letters of credit.

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Credit agreement and covenant-basis EBITDA are not supplied, and the pack stops at August 5, 2026.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a company measure with large add-backs, and covenant definitions are not supplied.
